question: You need to design a highly available Azure SQL database that meets the following requirements: • Failover between replicas of the database must occur without any data loss. • The database must remain available in the event of a zone outage. • Costs must be minimized. Which deployment option should you use?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Hyperscale 是一种适用于超大规模数据库的选项，支持快速扩展和高性能。 虽然它提供高可用性，但它的主要目标是处理超大规模数据，而不是专⻔优化区域故障转移。 此外，Hyperscale 的成本通常较高，不符合“成本最小化”的要求。 错误原因：不符合成本最小化的要求。
explanations.B: Correct. Azure SQL Database Premium Premium 层级专为高性能和高可用性设计，支持自动故障转移和区域冗余。 它提供了“Zone Redundant Configuration”，可以确保数据库在区域故障时仍然可用。 Premium 层级支持故障转移时无数据丢失，符合题目要求。 正确原因：满足高可用性、区域冗余和无数据丢失的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Basic Basic 层级是最低成本的选项，但它不支持高级的高可用性功能，例如区域冗余或自动故障转移。 故障转移可能会导致数据丢失，不符合题目要求。 错误原因：不支持区域冗余和无数据丢失的故障转移。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Standard Standard 层级提供了一些高可用性功能，但不支持 Premium 层级的“Zone Redundant Configuration”。 在区域故障时，Standard 层级可能无法保证数据库的可用性。 错误原因：不完全满足区域冗余的要求。

question: You are developing a sales application that will contain several Azure cloud services and handle different components of a transaction. Different cloud services will process customer orders, billing, payment, inventory, and shipping. You need to recommend a solution to enable the cloud services to asynchronously communicate transaction information by using XML messages. What should you include in the recommendation?

explanations.A: Correct. Azure Service Bus: Azure Service Bus 是一个消息队列服务，支持异步通信和 XML 消息传递。 它非常适合处理分布式系统中的事务信息传递。 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure Data Lake: Azure Data Lake 是一个大数据存储解决方案，主要用于存储和分析数据，而不是消息传递。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Azure Traffic Manager: Azure Traffic Manager 是一个流量分配服务，用于优化用戶访问的性能和分布，并不支持消息传递功能。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Blob Storage: Azure Blob Storage 是一个对象存储服务，主要用于存储文件和数据，而不是消息传递。 此选项错误。

question: You need to design a highly available Azure SQL database that meets the following requirements: • Failover between replicas of the database must occur without any data loss. • The database must remain available in the event of a zone outage. • Costs must be minimized. Which deployment option should you use?

options.B: Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose
options.D: Azure SQL Managed Instance Business Critical

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Basic 错误：Basic层不支持高可用性功能，也不支持区域故障恢复。 不满足无数据丢失的故障转移要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose 错误：General Purpose层提供基本的高可用性，但不支持区域故障恢复。 不满足“数据库在区域故障时仍可用”的要求。
explanations.C: Correct. Azure SQL Database Business Critical 正确：Business Critical层支持高可用性，提供多个副本，并支持区域故障恢复。 ( 故障转移无数据丢失，满足题目要求。 虽然成本较高，但在题目中未明确要求最低成本，而是要求“成本最小化”，此选项在高可用性和成本之间提供了合理的平衡。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure SQL Managed Instance Business Critical 错误：虽然Business Critical层支持高可用性，但Azure SQL Managed Instance的区域故障恢复能力不如Azure SQL Database。 不完全满足题目中“数据库在区域故障时仍可用”的要求。

question: You have an Azure subscription. You need to deploy an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) solution that will use Windows Server 2019 nodes. The solution must meet the following requirements: • Minimize the time it takes to provision compute resources during scale-out operations. • Support autoscaling of Windows Server containers. Which scaling option should you recommend?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Horizontal pod autoscaler 水平 Pod 自动扩展器 (HPA) 是 Kubernetes 的一个功能，用于根据负载动态调整 Pod 的数量。然而，它仅调整 Pod 的数量，并不直接 影响底层计算资源的扩展，因此无法满足“最小化计算资源的配置时间”的要求。此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Virtual nodes 虚拟节点允许 AKS 使用 Azure 容器实例 (ACI) 来运行 Pod，而无需预配置虚拟机。这可以快速扩展计算资源，但目前不支持 Windows Server 容器，因此不符合题目要求。此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Kubernetes version 1.20.2 or newer 虽然较新的 Kubernetes 版本可能支持更多功能，但题目并未要求特定版本的 Kubernetes，也没有直接说明版本更新可以解决扩展问 题。因此此选项与题目要求无关。此选项错误。
explanations.D: Correct. Cluster autoscaler 集群自动扩展器 (Cluster Autoscaler) 是 AKS 的一个功能，可以根据需求动态调整节点池的大小。它支持 Windows Server 节点，并能够 快速扩展计算资源以满足负载需求，同时支持自动扩展。此选项正确。

question: You are developing a sales application that will contain several Azure cloud services and handle different components of a transaction. Different cloud services will process customer orders, billing, payment, inventory, and shipping. You need to recommend a solution to enable the cloud services to asynchronously communicate transaction information by using XML messages. What should you include in the recommendation?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure Service Fabric Azure Service Fabric 是一个分布式系统平台，用于构建和管理微服务和容器化应用程序。它主要用于应用程序 的开发和部署，而不是专⻔设计用于异步消息传递。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure Data Lake Azure Data Lake 是一个大数据存储解决方案，主要用于存储和分析大规模数据，而不是用于服务之间的消息传递。 因此此选项错误。

explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Application Gateway Azure Application Gateway 是一个负载均衡器，主要用于管理和分发 HTTP 请求，而不是用于异步消息传 递。因此此选项错误。

question: Your company has offices in North America and Europe. You plan to migrate to Azure. You need to recommend a networking solution for the new Azure infrastructure. The solution must meet the following requirements: • The Point-to-Site (P2S) VPN connections of mobile users must connect automatically to the closest Azure region. • The offices in each region must connect to their local Azure region by using an ExpressRoute circuit. • Transitive routing between virtual networks and on-premises networks must be supported. • The network traffic between virtual networks must be filtered by using FQDNs. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: Azure Virtual WAN with a secured virtual hub
options.B: virtual network peering and application security groups
options.C: virtual network gateways and network security groups (NSGs)
options.D: Azure Route Server and Azure Network Function Manager

explanations.A: Correct. Azure Virtual WAN with a secured virtual hub 支持自动连接到最近的Azure区域，满足P2S VPN连接的需求。 支持ExpressRoute连接到本地Azure区域，满足办公室连接需求。 支持转发路由，满足虚拟网络和本地网络之间的路由需求。 支持基于FQDN的流量过滤，满足网络流量过滤需求。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Virtual network peering and application security groups 虚拟网络对等连接支持虚拟网络之间的连接，但不支持自动连接到最近的Azure区域。 应用安全组可以用于流量过滤，但不支持基于FQDN的过滤。 不满足所有需求，错误选项。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Virtual network gateways and network security groups (NSGs) 虚拟网络网关支持VPN连接，但不支持自动连接到最近的Azure区域。 网络安全组可以用于流量过滤，但不支持基于FQDN的过滤。 不满足所有需求，错误选项。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Route Server and Azure Network Function Manager Azure Route Server主要用于动态路由协议的管理，不支持自动连接到最近的Azure区域。 Azure Network Function Manager主要用于管理网络功能，不满足题目中的所有需求。 不满足所有需求，错误选项。

question: You need to design a highly available Azure SQL database that meets the following requirements: • Failover between replicas of the database must occur without any data loss. • The database must remain available in the event of a zone outage. • Costs must be minimized. Which deployment option should you use?

options.B: Azure SQL Managed Instance Business Critical
options.D: Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose

explanations.A: Correct. Azure SQL Database Business Critical 正确：Azure SQL Database Business Critical提供高可用性，支持自动故障转移到副本，并且使用“Zone Redundant”配置可以在区域故障 时保持可用性。 符合无数据丢失的要求，因为它使用同步复制。 虽然成本较高，但在满足高可用性和区域故障的情况下，这是最佳选择。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure SQL Managed Instance Business Critical 错误：虽然Azure SQL Managed Instance Business Critical也支持高可用性和同步复制，但它的主要目标是支持迁移现有的SQL Server工 作负载，而不是专⻔优化成本。 成本通常高于Azure SQL Database Business Critical。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Standard 错误：Azure SQL Database Standard不支持“Zone Redundant”配置，也不提供同步复制的高可用性。 在区域故障时无法保证数据库的可用性。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose 错误：Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose使用异步复制，无法保证无数据丢失。 不支持区域故障的高可用性。

question: You are designing a point of sale (POS) solution that will be deployed across multiple locations and will use an Azure Databricks workspace in the Standard tier. The solution will include multiple apps deployed to the on-premises network of each location. You need to configure the authentication method that will be used by the app to access the workspace. The solution must minimize the administrative effort associated with staff turnover and credential management. What should you configure?

explanations.A: Incorrect. a managed identity 托管身份是Azure资源的身份验证机制，适用于Azure资源之间的通信。由于题目中提到的是“on-premises network”，托管身份无法直接 用于本地应用程序与Azure Databricks的交互，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Correct. a service principal 服务主体是Azure AD中的应用程序对象，可以为应用程序提供安全的身份验证方式。它支持跨平台和跨网络的身份验证，适合本地 应用程序与Azure Databricks的交互。服务主体的管理工作量较低，尤其是在员工离职或更换时，只需管理服务主体的权限，而无需 更改个人凭据。因此此选项正确。
explanations.C: Correct. a personal access token 个人访问令牌是用戶生成的凭据，通常用于临时访问或开发测试场景。由于它与个人账戶绑定，员工离职或更换时需要重新生成令 牌，增加了管理工作量。因此此选项错误。

question: You have two Azure AD tenants named contoso.com and fabrikam.com. Each tenant is linked to 50 Azure subscriptions. Contoso.com contains two users named User1 and User2. You need to meet the following requirements: • Ensure that User1 can change the Azure AD tenant linked to specific Azure subscriptions. • If an Azure subscription is liked to a new Azure AD tenant, and no available Azure AD accounts have full subscription-level permissions to the subscription, elevate the access of User2 to the subscription. The solution must use the principle of least privilege. Which role should you assign to each user? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

explanations.1: User1 → Owner
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure⻆色的权限和功能，包括Owner、Co-administrator、Service administrator。 如何使用最小权限原则分配⻆色。 Azure AD租戶与订阅的关系管理。 2. 选项分析 对于User1： Co-administrator: 错误。Co-administrator⻆色可以管理订阅，但无法更改订阅关联的Azure AD租戶。 Owner: 正确。Owner⻆色拥有对订阅的完全控制权限，包括更改订阅关联的Azure AD租戶。 Service administrator: 错误。Service administrator⻆色主要用于管理订阅，但无法更改订阅关联的Azure AD租戶。 对于User2： Co-administrator: 错误。Co-administrator⻆色无法在没有其他用戶权限的情况下自动提升权限。 Owner: 正确。Owner⻆色可以在没有其他用戶权限的情况下自动提升权限，满足题目要求。 Service administrator: 错误。Service administrator⻆色无法自动提升权限。 3. 我的答案 User1: Owner User2: Owner 4. 官方答案 User1: Owner User2: Owner 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的地方。

question: You have a multi-tier app named App1 and an Azure SQL database named SQL1. The backend service of App1 writes data to SQL1. Users use the App1 client to read the data from SQL1. During periods of high utilization, the users experience delays retrieving the data. You need to minimize how long it takes for data requests. What should you include in the solution?

explanations.A: Correct. Azure Cache for Redis Redis是一种高性能的分布式缓存服务，适用于减少数据库读取压力。 在高负载情况下，可以将频繁访问的数据缓存到Redis中，从而减少直接访问SQL数据库的次数，显著提高数据读取速度。 此选项正确，因为它直接解决了用戶读取数据时的延迟问题。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) CDN主要用于优化静态内容（如图片、视频、文件）的分发，而不是动态数据的读取。 本题涉及的是数据库数据的读取延迟问题，CDN无法解决此问题。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Azure Data Factory Azure Data Factory是一种数据集成服务，主要用于数据的提取、转换和加载（ETL）操作。 它不适用于实时数据读取优化场景，因此无法解决用戶读取数据时的延迟问题。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Synapse Analytics Azure Synapse Analytics是一种数据分析服务，适用于大规模数据处理和分析。 虽然它可以处理复杂的查询，但它并不是专⻔设计用于减少实时数据读取延迟的问题。 此选项错误。

question: You are designing an app that will include two components. The components will communicate by sending messages via a queue. You need to recommend a solution to process the messages by using a First in, First out (FIFO) pattern. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: storage queues with a custom metadata setting
options.B: Azure Service Bus queues with partitioning enabled
options.C: Azure Service Bus queues with sessions enabled
options.D: storage queues with a stored access policy

explanations.A: Incorrect. Storage queues with a custom metadata setting 错误原因：Azure Storage Queue 不支持原生的 FIFO 排序。即使使用自定义元数据，也无法保证消息的 FIFO 处理。Storage Queue 是一 种简单的队列服务，主要用于基本的消息传递场景。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure Service Bus queues with partitioning enabled 错误原因：启用分区后，Azure Service Bus 的队列可能会打破 FIFO 顺序，因为分区会将消息分散到多个存储节点，无法保证严格的 FIFO 排序。
explanations.C: Correct. Azure Service Bus queues with sessions enabled 正确原因：Azure Service Bus 支持会话（Sessions），会话功能可以确保消息按照 FIFO 顺序进行处理。通过会话 ID，消息可以被分组 并按顺序处理，这是实现 FIFO 的推荐方法。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Storage queues with a stored access policy 错误原因：存储访问策略（Stored Access Policy）是用于管理权限的，与消息的 FIFO 排序无关。Azure Storage Queue 本身不支持 FIFO 排序。

question: You need to deploy an instance of SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines. The solution must meet the following requirements: • Support 15,000 disk IOPS. • Support SR-IOV. • Minimize costs. What should you include in the solution? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

explanations.1: Virtual machine series → DS
explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Virtual Machines的系列选择及其性能特点。 Azure磁盘类型的性能（IOPS）和成本优化。 支持SR-IOV（单根I/O虚拟化）的虚拟机系列。 2. 选项分析 虚拟机系列选项分析 DS: DS系列虚拟机支持高性能存储，并且支持SR-IOV。适合需要高IOPS的场景。 NC: NC系列虚拟机主要用于GPU计算，不适合高IOPS存储需求，也不支持SR-IOV。 NV: NV系列虚拟机主要用于图形密集型工作负载，不适合高IOPS存储需求，也不支持SR-IOV。 磁盘类型选项分析 Standard SSD: 性能较低，IOPS无法达到15,000的要求，成本较低。 Premium SSD: 性能较高，支持高IOPS（最高可达20,000），成本适中，适合此场景。 Ultra Disk: 性能最高，支持超高IOPS，但成本较高，不符合“最小化成本”的要求。 3. 我的答案 虚拟机系列: DS 磁盘类型: Premium SSD 4. 官方答案 虚拟机系列: DS 磁盘类型: Premium SSD 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 理由：DS系列虚拟机支持SR-IOV并提供高性能存储，Premium SSD满足15,000 IOPS的要求，同时成本适中。

question: You are developing an app that will use Azure Functions to process Azure Event Hubs events. Request processing is estimated to take between five and 20 minutes. You need to recommend a hosting solution that meets the following requirements: • Supports estimates of request processing runtimes • Supports event-driven autoscaling for the app Which hosting plan should you recommend?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Dedicated: Dedicated计划提供专用资源，但不支持事件驱动的自动扩展，因此不符合要求。

You need to recommend a solution to enable the cloud services to asynchronously communicate transaction information by using XML messages. What should you include in the recommendation?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure Blob Storage: Azure Blob Storage 是一种用于存储大量非结构化数据的服务，例如图像、视频或日志文件。它不适合用于异步消息传递，因为它缺 乏队列功能和消息处理机制。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure Data Lake: Azure Data Lake 是一种用于存储和分析大规模数据的服务，主要用于大数据处理场景。它不支持消息队列功能，也不适合异步通 信。因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Correct. Azure Queue Storage: Azure Queue Storage 是一种消息队列服务，专⻔设计用于异步通信。它支持 XML 消息的传递，并允许不同的云服务之间进行可靠的 异步通信。这正是题目要求的解决方案，因此此选项正确。
explanations.D: Incorrect. Azure Service Fabric: Azure Service Fabric 是一个分布式系统平台，用于构建微服务和容器化应用程序。虽然它可以用于构建复杂的应用程序，但它不是专 ⻔设计用于异步消息传递的服务。因此此选项错误。

question: You need to design a highly available Azure SQL database that meets the following requirements: • Failover between replicas of the database must occur without any data loss. • The database must remain available in the event of a zone outage. • Costs must be minimized. Which deployment option should you use?

options.B: Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose

explanations.A: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Serverless Serverless模式适用于间歇性工作负载，能够根据需求自动扩展计算资源。 它不提供区域冗余或高可用性功能，因此无法满足“数据库必须在区域故障时保持可用”的要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure SQL Managed Instance General Purpose General Purpose层提供基本的高可用性，但不支持区域冗余。 在区域故障时，数据库可能不可用，因此不符合题目要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Azure SQL Database Basic Basic层是最低成本的选项，但它不支持高可用性或区域冗余。 无法满足“无数据丢失”和“区域故障时保持可用”的要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Correct. Azure SQL Database Business Critical Business Critical层提供高可用性和区域冗余，支持自动故障转移且无数据丢失。 它能够在区域故障时保持数据库可用，完全符合题目要求。 虽然成本较高，但题目要求优先满足高可用性，因此此选项正确。

question: You are developing a multi-tier app named App1 that will be hosted on Azure virtual machines. The peak utilization periods for App1 will be from 8 AM to 9 AM and 4 PM to 5 PM on weekdays. You need to deploy the infrastructure for App1. The solution must meet the following requirements: • Support virtual machines deployed to four availability zones across two Azure regions. • Minimize costs by accumulating CPU credits during periods of low utilization. What is the minimum number of virtual networks you should deploy, and which virtual machine size should you use? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

explanations.1: Number of virtual networks → 2

question: You have an Azure subscription that contains an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) instance named AKS1. AKS1 hosts microservice-based APIs that are configured to listen on non-default HTTP ports. You plan to deploy a Standard tier Azure API Management instance named APIM1 that will make the APIs available to external users. You need to ensure that the AKS1 APIs are accessible to APIM1. The solution must meet the following requirements: • Implement MTLS authentication between APIM1 and AKS1. • Minimize development effort. • Minimize costs. What should you do?

options.A: Implement an external load balancer on AKS1.
options.B: Redeploy APIM1 to the virtual network that contains AKS1.
options.C: Implement an ExternalName service on AKS1.
options.D: Deploy an ingress controller to AKS1.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Implement an external load balancer on AKS1. 错误：虽然外部负载均衡器可以使 AKS1 的服务对外部访问，但它无法直接满足 MTLS 认证的需求。 此外，外部负载均衡器的成本较高，不符合“最小化成本”的要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Redeploy APIM1 to the virtual network that contains AKS1. 错误：将 APIM1 部署到 AKS1 的虚拟网络中可以解决网络访问问题，但这并不能直接实现 MTLS 认证。 此外，重新部署 APIM1 需要额外的开发工作，不符合“最小化开发工作”的要求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Implement an ExternalName service on AKS1. 错误：ExternalName 服务主要用于 DNS 名称解析，无法直接解决 MTLS 认证或 API 的外部访问问题。 此选项不符合题目要求的功能需求。
explanations.D: Correct. Deploy an ingress controller to AKS1. 正确：Ingress 控制器可以管理 HTTP 和 HTTPS 流量，并支持配置 MTLS 认证。 它是 AKS 中常用的解决方案，能够最小化开发工作，同时成本较低。

explanations._full: 知识点分析 本题考查的具体知识点是 Azure 中的Azure Key Vault 与托管标识（Managed Identity）的集成使用，以及如何通过适当的授权机制（如 ⻆色分配或访问策略）来确保安全访问密钥和机密。 建议答案： 选项分析 Authenticate App1 by using: A certificate: 错误。证书可以用于身份验证，但在 Azure 中，推荐使用托管标识来简化身份验证流程并避免管理证书的复杂性。 A system-assigned managed identity: 正确。系统分配的托管标识是 Azure 提供的一种内置功能，允许 Azure 资源（如虚拟机或应用服 务）安全地访问其他 Azure 服务（如 Key Vault），无需显式管理凭据。 A user-assigned managed identity: 错误。虽然用戶分配的托管标识也可以用于身份验证，但题目未提到需要跨资源共享标识的场景， 因此系统分配的托管标识更适合。 Authorize App1 to retrieve Key Vault secrets by using: An access policy: 错误。访问策略是 Key Vault 的旧版授权机制，Azure 建议使用基于 Azure RBAC 的⻆色分配来管理访问权限。 A connected service: 错误。此选项与 Azure DevOps 的服务连接相关，不适用于 Key Vault 的授权场景。 A private link: 错误。私有链接用于确保网络级别的安全性，而非授权机制。 A role assignment: 正确。⻆色分配是 Azure RBAC 的核心功能，允许通过分配特定⻆色（如“Key Vault Secrets User”）来控制对 Key Vault 的访问。 推荐答案 Authenticate App1 by using: A system-assigned managed identity Authorize App1 to retrieve Key Vault secrets by using: A role assignment 官方答案 Authenticate App1 by using: A system-assigned managed identity Authorize App1 to retrieve Key Vault secrets by using: A role assignment 答案对比与验证 官方答案与推荐答案一致，均为正确答案。理由是系统分配的托管标识和⻆色分配是当前 Azure 中推荐的最佳实践，符合题目要求 的安全性和功能性。

explanations._full: 题目分析与解答 1. 考察的知识点 Azure Storage解决方案的选择与配置。 如何满足安全和合规性要求，例如数据写入和修改的限制。 如何满足业务需求，例如支持App1的存储需求。 2. 选项分析 Storage account type: Premium page blobs: 错误。Premium page blobs主要用于高性能的虚拟机磁盘存储，不适合满足App1的需求，尤其是数据写入和修改限制的合规性要求。 Premium file shares: 错误。Premium file shares主要用于文件共享场景，不支持Hierarchical namespace，也无法满足数据写入和修改限制的合规性要求。 Standard general-purpose v2: 正确。Standard general-purpose v2支持多种存储类型（Blob、File、Queue、Table），并且支持Hierarchical namespace，能够满足安全和 Litware identifies the following security and compliance requirements: ✑ Once App1 is migrated to Azure, you must ensure that new data can be written to the app, and the modification of new and existing data is prevented for a period of three years. ✑ On-premises users and services must be able to access the Azure Storage account that will host the data in App1. ✑ Access to the public endpoint of the Azure Storage account that will host the App1 data must be prevented. All Azure SQL databases in the production environment must have Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled. ✑ App1 must NOT share physical hardware with other workloads. Box 2: Hierarchical namespace - Scenario: Plan: Migrate App1 to Azure virtual machines. Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 implements an access control model that supports both Azure role-based access control (Azure RBAC) and POSIX-like access control lists (ACLs). Data Lake Storage Gen2 and the Network File System (NFS) 3.0 protocol both require a storage account with a hierarchical namespace enabled. Reference: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/data-protection-overview https://docs.microsoft.com/en- us/azure/storage/blobs/immutable-storage-overview 框 1：Standard general-purpose v2 Standard general-purpose v2 支持 Blob Storage。 Azure Storage 为 Blob Storage 和 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 提供数据保护。 场景： Litware 确定以下安全和合规需求： ✑ App1 迁移到 Azure 后，必须确保可以向应用写入新数据，并且在三年内禁止修改新数据和现有数据。 ✑ 本地用戶和服务必须能够访问将托管 App1 数据的 Azure Storage 账戶。 ✑ 必须阻止对将托管 App1 数据的 Azure Storage 账戶的公共端点的访问。 生产环境中的所有 Azure SQL 数据库必须启用透明数据加密 (TDE)。 ✑ App1 不得与其他工作负载共享物理硬件。 框 2：Hierarchical namespace - 场景：计划：将 App1 迁移到 Azure 虚拟机。 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 实现了一个访问控制模型，该模型支持 Azure ⻆色基于访问控制 (Azure RBAC) 和类似 POSIX 的访问控 制列表 (ACLs)。 Data Lake Storage Gen2 和网络文件系统 (NFS) 3.0 协议都需要启用分层命名空间的存储账戶。 参考： https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/data-protection-overview https://docs.microsoft.com/en- us/azure/storage/blobs/immutable-storage-overview 合规性要求。 Configuration: NFSv3: 错误。NFSv3主要用于文件共享场景，不支持Hierarchical namespace，也无法满足数据写入和修改限制的合规性要求。 Large file shares: 错误。Large file shares主要用于扩展文件共享容量，不支持Hierarchical namespace，也无法满足数据写入和修改限制的合规性要求。 Hierarchical namespace: 正确。Hierarchical namespace支持数据分层管理，适合满足安全和合规性要求，例如数据写入和修改限制。 3. 我选的答案 Storage account type: Standard general-purpose v2 Configuration: Hierarchical namespace 4. 官方答案 Storage account type: Standard general-purpose v2 Configuration: Hierarchical namespace 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 没有需要重新思考的地方。

explanations.A: Incorrect. Microsoft peering for an ExpressRoute circuit 错误原因：Microsoft Peering允许访问Azure公共服务（如Azure Storage和SQL Database），但它无法满足“防止公共端点访问”的安全要 求。此外，Microsoft Peering主要用于跨网络访问，而不是专⻔用于限制访问到特定资源。
explanations.B: Incorrect. Azure public peering for an ExpressRoute circuit 错误原因：Azure Public Peering已被弃用，且它允许通过公共IP地址访问Azure服务，这与“防止公共端点访问”的要求相冲突。
explanations.C: Incorrect. a service endpoint that has a service endpoint policy 错误原因：服务端点可以将流量限制到Azure虚拟网络，但它仍然使用公共IP地址进行通信，无法完全满足“防止公共端点访问”的要 求。此外，服务端点政策的功能有限，无法提供与私有端点相同的级别的安全性。
explanations.D: Correct. a private endpoint 正确原因：私有端点允许通过专用IP地址访问Azure资源，完全避免了公共端点的使用，满足了“防止公共端点访问”的安全要求。此 外，它与混合网络环境兼容，可以通过ExpressRoute或VPN进行访问。

The company has a main office in London and three branch offices in Amsterdam, Berlin, and Rome. Existing Environment: Active Directory Environment The network contains two Active Directory forests named corp.fabrikam.com and rd.fabrikam.com. There are no trust relationships between the forests. Corp.fabrikam.com is a production forest that contains identities used for internal user and computer authentication. Rd.fabrikam.com is used by the research and development (R&D) department only. The R&D department is restricted to using on - premises resources only. Existing Environment: Network Infrastructure Each office has at least one domain controller from the corp.fabrikam.com domain. The main office contains all the domain controllers for the rd.fabrikam.com forest. All the offices have a high - speed connection to the internet. An existing application named WebApp1 is hosted in the data center of the London office. WebApp1 is used by customers to place and track orders. WebApp1 has a web tier that uses Microsoft Information Services (IIS) and a database tier that runs Microsoft SQL Server 2016. The web tier and the database tier are deployed to virtual machines that run on Hyper - V. The IT department currently uses a separate Hyper - V environment to test updates to WebApp1. Fabrikam purchases all Microsoft licenses through a Microsoft Enterprise Agreement that includes Software Assurance. Existing Environment: Problem Statements The use of WebApp1 is unpredictable. At peak times, users often report delays. At other times, many resources for WebApp1 are underutilized. Requirements: Planned Changes - Fabrikam plans to move most of its production workloads to Azure during the next few years, including virtual machines that rely on Active Directory for authentication. As one of its first projects, the company plans to establish a hybrid identity model, facilitating an upcoming Microsoft 365 deployment. All R&D operations will remain on - premises. Fabrikam plans to migrate the production and test instances of WebApp1 to Azure. Requirements: Technical Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following technical requirements: Website content must be easily updated from a single point. User input must be minimized when provisioning new web app instances. Whenever possible, existing on - premises licenses must be used to reduce cost. Users must always authenticate by using their corp.fabrikam.com UPN identity. Any new deployments to Azure must be redundant in case an Azure region fails. Whenever possible, solutions must be deployed to Azure by using the Standard pricing tier of Azure App Service. An email distribution group named IT Support must be notified of any issues relating to the directory synchronization services. In the event that a link fails between Azure and the on - premises network, ensure that the virtual machines hosted in Azure can authenticate to Active Directory. Directory synchronization between Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and corp.fabrikam.com must not be affected by a link failure between Azure and the on - premises network. Requirements: Database Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following database requirements: Database metrics for the production instance of WebApp1 must be available for analysis so that database administrators can optimize the performance settings. To avoid disrupting customer access, database downtime must be minimized when databases are migrated. Database backups must be retained for a minimum of seven years to meet compliance requirements. Requirements: Security Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following security requirements: Company information including policies, templates, and data must be inaccessible to anyone outside the company. Users on the on - premises network must be able to authenticate to corp.fabrikam.com if an internet link fails. Administrators must be able to authenticate to the Azure portal by using their corp.fabrikam.com credentials. All administrative access to the Azure portal must be secured by using multi - factor authentication (MFA). The testing of WebApp1 updates must not be visible to anyone outside the company. An existing application named WebApp1 is hosted in the data center of the London office. WebApp1 is used by customers to place and track orders. WebApp1 has a web tier that uses Microsoft Information Services (IIS) and a database tier that runs Microsoft SQL Server 2016. The web tier and the database tier are deployed to virtual machines that run on Hyper - V. The IT department currently uses a separate Hyper - V environment to test updates to WebApp1. Fabrikam purchases all Microsoft licenses through a Microsoft Enterprise Agreement that includes Software Assurance. Existing Environment: Problem Statements The use of WebApp1 is unpredictable. At peak times, users often report delays. At other times, many resources for WebApp1 are underutilized. Requirements: Planned Changes - Fabrikam plans to move most of its production workloads to Azure during the next few years, including virtual machines that rely on Active Directory for authentication. As one of its first projects, the company plans to establish a hybrid identity model, facilitating an upcoming Microsoft 365 deployment. All R&D operations will remain on - premises. Fabrikam plans to migrate the production and test instances of WebApp1 to Azure. Requirements: Technical Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following technical requirements: Website content must be easily updated from a single point. User input must be minimized when provisioning new web app instances. Whenever possible, existing on - premises licenses must be used to reduce cost. Whenever possible, solutions must be deployed to Azure by using the Standard pricing tier of Azure App Service. An email distribution group named IT Support must be notified of any issues relating to the directory synchronization services. In the event that a link fails between Azure and the on - premises network, ensure that the virtual machines hosted in Azure can authenticate to Active Directory. Directory synchronization between Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and corp.fabrikam.com must not be affected by a link failure between Azure and the on - premises network. Requirements: Security Requirements Fabrikam identifies the following security requirements: Company information including policies, templates, and data must be inaccessible to anyone outside the company. Data written by any App1 instance must be visible to all App1 instances. App1 will only be accessible from the internet. App1 has the following connection requirements: Connections to App1 must pass through a web application firewall (WAF). Connections to App1 must be active - active load balanced between instances. All connections to App1 from North America must be directed to the East US region. All other connections must be directed to the West Europe region. Every hour, you will run a maintenance task by invoking a PowerShell script that copies files from all the App1 instances. The PowerShell script will run from a central location. Requirements: App2 - App2 will be a.NET app hosted in App Service that requires a Windows runtime. App2 has the following file storage requirements: Save files to an Azure Storage account. Replicate files to an on - premises location. Ensure that on - premises clients can read the files over the LAN by using the SMB protocol. You need to monitor App2 to analyze how long it takes to perform different transactions within the application. The solution must not require changes to the application code. The development process must meet the following requirements: A staging instance of a new application version must be deployed to the application host before the new version is used in production. The switch to the new application version from staging to production must occur without any downtime of the application. Accounts that no longer need permissions must be removed as guests. The solution must minimize development effort. Accounts that no longer need permissions must be removed as guests. * The solution must minimize development effort. Box 1: Azure AD Identity Governance Incorrect: Not PIM: Life Cycle Requirements must be met. Box 2: Access reviews - Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) access reviews enable organizations to efficiently manage group memberships, access to enterprise applications, and role assignments. User's access can be reviewed on a regular basis to make sure only the right people have continued access. Reference: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/governance/access-reviews-overview 需求：身份需求 Contoso 确定了以下需求以管理 Fabrikam 对资源的访问： * 每月，Fabrikam 的账戶经理必须审查哪些 Fabrikam 用戶具有对 App1 的访问权限。不再需要权限的账戶必须作为来宾被移除。 * 解决方案必须尽量减少开发工作量。 框 1：Azure AD Identity Governance 不正确： 不是 PIM：必须满足生命周期需求。 框 2：Access reviews - Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) 访问审查使组织能够高效管理组成员资格、对企业应用程序的访问以及⻆色分配。用戶的访问可以 定期审查，以确保只有合适的人继续拥有访问权限。 参考： https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/governance/access-reviews-overview Azure AD Identity Governance的功能和用途。 Access Reviews的作用，尤其是在管理外部用戶访问权限时的应用。 2. 选项分析 Service选项分析： Azure AD Identity Governance: 正确。Identity Governance提供了管理用戶访问权限的功能，包括Access Reviews，适合定期审查外部用 戶的访问权限。 Azure AD Identity Protection: 错误。Identity Protection主要用于检测和响应潜在的安全⻛险，而不是管理用戶访问权限。 Azure AD Privilege Access Management (PIM): 错误。PIM主要用于管理和控制特权账戶的访问权限，而不是定期审查外部用戶的访问 权限。 Azure Automation: 错误。Azure Automation主要用于自动化任务和脚本运行，与用戶访问权限管理无关。 Feature选项分析： Access packages: 错误。Access packages用于定义一组资源的访问权限，但不适合定期审查用戶权限。 Access reviews: 正确。Access Reviews允许管理员定期审查和管理用戶的访问权限，特别是外部用戶的权限。 Approvals: 错误。Approvals用于审批流程，与定期审查用戶权限无关。 Runbooks: 错误。Runbooks用于自动化任务，与用戶权限管理无关。 3. 我的答案 Service: Azure AD Identity Governance Feature: Access reviews 4. 官方答案 Service: Azure AD Identity Governance Feature: Access reviews 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 无需重新思考或修改答案。

Reference: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/traffic-manager/traffic-manager-overview https://docs.microsoft.com/en- us/azure/networking/disaster-recovery-dns-traffic-manager 框 1：是 - 任何新的 Azure 部署必须具有冗余，以防 Azure 区域发生故障。 Traffic Manager 对故障具有弹性，包括整个 Azure 区域的故障。 框 2：否 - Traffic Manager 提供负载均衡，但不提供自动扩展。 框 3：否 - 使用 Azure Traffic Manager 的自动故障转移：当您有复杂架构和多个能够执行相同功能的资源集时，您可以配置 Azure Traffic Manager（基于 DNS）检查资源的运行状况，并将流量从非健康资源路由到健康资源。 参考： https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/traffic-manager/traffic-manager-overview https://docs.microsoft.com/en- us/azure/networking/disaster-recovery-dns-traffic-manager 2. 选项分析 The design supports the technical requirements for redundancy: 正确。Azure Traffic Manager可以在多个区域之间分发流量，并提供区域冗余支持。如果一个区域不可用，流量会自动转移到另一个 区域，从而满足冗余要求。 The design supports autoscaling: 错误。虽然Azure Web App支持自动扩展，但题目中并未提到启用了自动扩展配置。因此，设计不支持自动扩展。 The design requires a manual configuration if an Azure region fails: 错误。Azure Traffic Manager会自动处理区域故障，无需手动干预。因此设计不需要手动配置。 3. 我的答案 The design supports the technical requirements for redundancy: Yes The design supports autoscaling: No The design requires a manual configuration if an Azure region fails: No 4. 官方答案 The design supports the technical requirements for redundancy: Yes The design supports autoscaling: No The design requires a manual configuration if an Azure region fails: No 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案完全一致，无需重新思考。
